subject: Status: benchmark repro + June critical path
body:
Status.

Repro: benchmark numbers reproduced for the main transfer setting — models trained on the source graph and evaluated on disjoint-node test graphs degrade exactly as the benchmark documents, and the mitigation strategies in the release recover a good share of the gap on most dataset pairs.

The interesting internal question is which regime our domains fall into: structural similarity between source and target predicts transfer quality strongly in our repro, and our two candidate internal domains differ a lot on that axis. Gustavo's prep suggests domain A (session graphs) should transfer well; domain B (entity graphs) may be the stress case.

Risk: memory. Temporal batching on our largest internal snapshot exceeds single-node limits, so Bilal is sharding the loader; if that isn't done by Jun 12 we'll burn reserved capacity on smaller-than-planned runs. That's the June critical path.

Ondrej
